content.user_title: Draft Better Documents With Guided Co-Authoring
content.value_statement: Long documents often fail when context, structure, and reader assumptions are unclear. This skill guides context gathering, section drafting, refinement, and reader testing.
actual_capabilities: Guides a three-stage workflow for context gathering, structured drafting, and reader testing.
Generates clarifying questions about audience, impact, constraints, templates, and missing context.
Creates document scaffolds with section headers and placeholder content.
Supports brainstorming, curation, gap checks, and iterative section refinement.
Tests reader comprehension with sub-agents or manual Claude prompts.
limitations: Requires user-supplied context, templates, files, or connector access.
Does not verify factual accuracy, links, or technical correctness.
Reader testing depends on available sub-agents or manual Claude conversations.
Best suited for substantial documents, not quick notes or simple edits.

use_cases.title: Draft Decision Documents
use_cases.description: Turn rough project context into a decision document with clear audience, impact, options, and trade-offs.

use_cases.title: Build Product Specs
use_cases.description: Build PRDs or technical specs section by section while preserving team context and constraints.

use_cases.title: Test Reader Understanding
use_cases.description: Review an existing draft with reader questions, ambiguity checks, and targeted edits before broader review.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Document Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin a new substantial document from limited context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through the document coauthoring workflow for a decision doc. Ask the initial context questions first.

prompt_templates.title: Structure Rough Notes
prompt_templates.scenario: Convert an information dump into a useful outline.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this rough context to propose a document structure, then help me choose the best first section to draft.

prompt_templates.title: Refine an Existing Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve a draft without rewriting everything at once.
prompt_templates.prompt: Read my existing draft, identify unclear sections, then guide targeted edits with section-by-section feedback.

prompt_templates.title: Run Reader Testing
prompt_templates.scenario: Check whether the document works for new readers.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run reader testing for this document. Predict reader questions, test assumptions, summarize gaps, and propose precise fixes.

output_examples.input: I need to write a decision doc from scattered project notes.
output: A context intake with audience, impact, template, constraints, and missing information questions.
A proposed document outline with placeholders for major sections.
A section-by-section drafting plan for refinement.

output_examples.input: We have a nearly finished technical spec and need reader testing.
output: Realistic reader questions for discovery and comprehension.
A summary of likely ambiguity, assumed knowledge, and contradictions.
Targeted revision suggestions for sections that confuse readers.

output_examples.input: I want to edit an existing proposal without losing team context.
output: Clarifying questions about stakeholders, constraints, and open decisions.
Brainstormed additions and removals for each section.
Focused edits that preserve document flow and user priorities.

best_practices: Provide audience, desired impact, constraints, and templates before drafting.
Keep feedback specific so the skill can learn your writing preferences.
Run reader testing before sharing the document with a broader audience.
anti_patterns: Do not skip context gathering for complex or high-stakes documents.
Do not treat reader testing as fact checking or expert review.
Do not paste sensitive team content unless the workspace policy allows it.

faq.question: Does this skill write the whole document at once?
faq.answer: No. It guides section-by-section drafting so context, structure, and feedback stay clear.

faq.question: Can it work with existing documents?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review an existing draft or template when the user provides a file, link, or accessible connector context.

faq.question: Does it require Claude connectors?
faq.answer: No. Connectors help gather context, but users can paste content directly when integrations are unavailable.

faq.question: What is reader testing?
faq.answer: Reader testing asks a fresh Claude instance to answer likely reader questions and identify unclear assumptions.

faq.question: Can Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow applies to Codex and Claude Code when document files are edited in a workspace.

faq.question: Does it verify facts?
faq.answer: No. Users must check facts, links, technical details, and organizational claims before publishing.
